guardians.powerPrinciple: Volition Energy generated by consequential committed choice
guardians.failureMode: indecision, selfish refusal to commit or using freedom of choice to avoid responsibility

guardians.powerPrinciple: Courage converts accepted danger into escalating force, resilience and forward momentum
guardians.failureMode: recklessness and mistaking fearlessness for courage

guardians.powerPrinciple: Wisdom reveals patterns, relationships and structural weaknesses without granting omniscience
guardians.failureMode: detachment, paralysis through analysis and valuing knowledge above people

guardians.powerPrinciple: Freedom manipulates movement, air lanes and release from physical restraint without mind control
guardians.failureMode: lawlessness and refusing all responsibility or bonds
guardians.conflictResolution: Skyhaven is the realm; Aerion Skyfarers are Lyra's people and airborne political culture

guardians.powerPrinciple: Justice creates measured defensive and judgment-based energy that grows stronger when protecting a clearly defined lawful principle
guardians.failureMode: tyranny, absolutism and punishing without understanding context

guardians.powerPrinciple: Sacrifice converts willingly surrendered personal advantage, stamina or safety into temporary protective or destructive power
guardians.failureMode: martyrdom addiction and sacrificing oneself or others when another path exists

guardians.powerPrinciple: Truth exposes concealment, false structures and contradictions but cannot read minds or force confession
guardians.failureMode: cruelty disguised as honesty and treating truth as more important than mercy or context

systemRules: A Legendary Deck chooses a bearer who can embody its value while retaining free will.
A Deck is not a crown and gives no automatic political authority over its realm.
A Guardian can fail morally without immediately losing the Deck; prolonged betrayal of the core value destabilizes access to higher techniques.
No Guardian can legitimately command another Guardian's Deck.
The Dealer cannot use any Legendary Deck.
The House seeks to bind all seven Decks into one authority at the Final Table, which would invert the First Deal and reduce free will across Asterion.
The seven values must cooperate voluntarily for the First Deal to remain valid. Forced unity is treated as a failure of the system.
